requirements.name: RF measurement experience
requirements.note: CV and cover letter describe optical measurement instruments (spectrophotometers, optical power meters, oscilloscopes) but do not mention RF-specific test equipment (network analysers, spectrum analysers, anechoic-chamber measurement, RF front-end calibration).

requirements.name: Relevant degree or demonstrated equivalent

lines.quote: My master's was in communication sciences, and while it gave me solid training in research methodology and data analysis, the optics and sensor technology side was entirely new.
Designed the test framework and authored all validation reports and customer documentation in English for the OEM partner Hoshizora Lighting Corporation

requirements.note: Stated degree (Communication Sciences) is not in the requirement's named fields. Status reflects the concrete on-the-job technical detail quoted above as possible demonstrated-equivalent competence; whether it counts as equivalent is a judgement call for the recruiter.

lines.quote: Employed on a permanent contract; holder of a Finnish permanent residence permit with full EU/EEA work authorisation
authored all validation reports and customer documentation in English for the OEM partner Hoshizora Lighting Corporation
Based at the Boreal Photonics Oulu facility since 2015
Oulu has been home for several years now, and I have no plans to leave.

ask_in_screening.question: Can you describe any experience you have designing or implementing phased-array or beamforming signal-processing algorithms, if any?
Can you describe any experience writing embedded signal-processing software in C or C++ running on real hardware under real timing constraints, if any?
Can you describe any experience writing Python to production or engineering standards, if any?
Can you describe any hands-on RF test-bench experience you have, such as with network analysers, spectrum analysers, or anechoic-chamber measurement, if any?
